meta.scope: Public-source credit research for material or stressed borrowers that overlap the BDC and senior-loan ETF datasets.
meta.methodology: Research signals provide context for observed marks and refinancing risk. They do not mechanically determine fair value and are kept separate from the ETF-implied pricing calculation.

rows.headline: Lender coordination raises refinancing and liability-management risk
rows.summary: A majority of lenders to the roughly $2.1 billion first-lien term loan due in 2028 reportedly entered a cooperation agreement for potential debt talks. The public ETF mark subsequently sits in the low 70s, while Cornerstone continues to report operating and product milestones.

sources.title: Software Firm Cornerstone's Lenders Sign Pact for Debt Talks
Cornerstone achieves DISA Impact Level 4 authorization

rows.headline: CCC+ downgrade and a difficult 2028 refinancing wall
rows.summary: S&P lowered Peraton to CCC+ with a negative outlook, citing weaker expected earnings and cash flow, a book-to-bill ratio below 1x, and the need to refinance approximately $5.7 billion of first-lien debt due February 2028.

rows.headline: Downgrade confirms weakening software-credit momentum
rows.summary: S&P's June 2026 BSL surveillance records a downgrade of Kaseya to B- from B with a stable outlook. That action is directionally consistent with the ETF mark falling to roughly 80 cents.

rows.headline: Large, layered capital structure makes tranche identity essential
rows.summary: Cloud Software has substantial first- and second-lien debt with materially different recovery expectations. Its acquisition of Arctera closed outside the borrowing group, reinforcing that borrower-level headlines and marks should not be applied blindly across facilities.

sources.title: Cloud Software first-lien notes and recovery analysis
Arctera ratings withdrawn after Cloud Software acquisition

rows.headline: 2025 refinancing extended the runway and added sponsor equity
rows.summary: Trucordia completed a comprehensive refinancing that included a $1.94 billion seven-year term loan B, a $400 million revolver, second-lien financing, and a new Carlyle equity investment.

rows.headline: Acquisition financing changed the debt stack in 2025
rows.summary: A roughly $1.6 billion financing package was launched to fund Proofpoint's Hornetsecurity acquisition and refinance debt. Current facility matching therefore relies on the repriced 2028 term-loan maturity and rate rather than older borrower-level debt descriptions.

rows.headline: Second-lien maturity was extended to October 2028
rows.summary: The $575 million second-lien term loan was amended and extended from July 2026 to October 2028. S&P assigned a CCC+ debt rating to the proposed facility, making the exact second-lien match more informative than a borrower-wide average.

sources.title: Edelman proposed second-lien term loan rated CCC+

rows.headline: Multiple new facilities reduce the value of a borrower-only comparison
rows.summary: Public filings show separate first-lien facilities maturing in 2028 and 2032 with different spreads. ETF marks should only be translated to a BDC position after matching the specific maturity and currency.

sources.title: Public filing with Flexera first-lien facilities
Flexera majority investment by Thoma Bravo
